text:
Eleanor: Tiny moment to thank Vik and Gabe for rescuing the office plant corner this morning  the watering schedule was missed and two sunflowers were wilting. You both swooped in! :seedling:

Vik: It was a team lift  grabbed watering cans from Facilities and re-potted one of the sunflowers. Left a note on the whiteboard: "Plant heroes: Vik & Gabe".

Gabe: Also taught Tom the two-step watering trick (less is more). Tom, youre on morning checks tomorrow :sunrise:

Tom: Affirmative, will add to my morning loop. Thanks for the quick lesson! I'll log the schedule in the office binder and in the shared doc: https://redwood.internal/office/plants

Sana: Big ❤️ to you all. Bringing a small jar of plant food tomorrow as a thank-you. Also starting a Kudos ripple: who wants to add a shoutout? :wave:

meme-bot: GIF https://giphy.com/gifs/plant-rescue-joy-plant123 :plant_rescue:

kudos-bot: Eleanor gave Vik a "Green Thumb" kudos (reason: re-potted sunflower) :trophy:

Eleanor: And Gabe gets a "Sunflower Savoir" kudos for steady hands.

kudos-bot: Eleanor gave Gabe a "Sunflower Savior" kudos (reason: handled delicate roots) :star2:

Vik: Passing my kudos to Sana for organizing the binder and adding the watering rota.

kudos-bot: Vik gave Sana a "Caretaker" kudos (reason: started the office plant doc) :leafy_green:

Gabe: Also shoutout to Facilities for letting us borrow the dolly yesterday  moving pots is easier with wheels. @Facilities you rule.

Tom: Poll: rotate plant duty weekly or biweekly? vote: weekly/biweekly

Eleanor: biweekly

Vik: weekly

Gabe: biweekly

Sana: biweekly (less chance of accidental overwatering)

Tom: biweekly it is. I'll update the doc and calendar slot.

Sana: GIF: https://giphy.com/gifs/thanks-team-joyful-xyz789

Eleanor: Thanks team. Little thing, big community vibe. Please drop any extra kudos in the #kudos board so we can highlight in the monthly round-up :sparkles:
